executive_summary: Manufacturing Factory UI destructively removed. Sovereign Enterprise Platform architecture restored with 6 Sovereign Products and 8 Independent Shared Platforms accessible directly in UEOS Shell navigation and Commercial Products Ecosystem.
core_invariants: Platform Kernel -> Sovereign Product -> Directorate -> Department -> Portal -> Module hierarchy is immutable.
The 6 Sovereign Products are peer commercial products, never subordinate to each other.
The 8 Independent Platforms provide shared infrastructure services, never embedded into a single product.
No factory/pipeline/blueprint manufacturing UI is to be re-introduced.
